title: A merge patch array that replaces a flow sequence member is written as a flow sequence
notes: RFC 7396 replaces the array as a whole. The replaced value keeps its style when that style can hold the new value (docs/edit-semantics.md, The value keeps its style); the sibling stays as it was. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend kept the flow style; the native backend rewrote the member as a block sequence.
